title.en: Help and the user guide, inside the app
title.zh: 在应用内找到帮助和使用文档

description.en: Help in the Computer sidebar shows the tour again and opens the guide: how Workspace and Computer differ, connecting and managing agents, and everything else. In a workspace, the same guide is under Help & docs in the account menu. The guide opens in your app language.
description.zh: 「此电脑」侧栏新增「帮助」，可以重新查看引导，也可以打开使用文档：「工作区」和「此电脑」的区别、连接和管理智能体，以及全部文档。在工作区里，同样的文档在账号菜单的「帮助与文档」中。文档按应用语言打开。

title.en: The tour explains Computer and Workspace
title.zh: 引导会说明「此电脑」和「工作区」的分工

description.en: It starts at the switch between the two: Computer is where you install, sign in and configure agents, Workspace is where you work with your team and its agents. It ends at Help, where you can start it again.
description.zh: 引导从两者之间的切换开始：「此电脑」用来安装、登录和配置智能体，「工作区」是和成员、智能体一起协作的地方。引导最后停在「帮助」，可以随时从那里重新查看。

description.en: Signing in from a terminal now says to type /login inside WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy), and that the international and China sites are separate accounts.
description.zh: 在终端里登录时，会提示在 WorkBuddy（CodeBuddy）里输入 /login，并说明国际站和国内站是两套独立账号。

title.en: How to use a saved model access
title.zh: 说明怎样使用已保存的模型访问

description.en: Settings → Model access shows how to give a saved credential to an agent and check that it works.
description.zh: 「设置 → 模型访问」页会说明如何把已保存的凭据给智能体使用，以及如何确认它已生效。

title.en: WorkBuddy no longer reads "not signed in" after you sign in
title.zh: WorkBuddy 登录后不再提示「设备上还没有登录」

description.en: A WorkBuddy agent signed in with /login is recognized as signed in, and the smoke test now runs on the site (international or China) the agent is set to, so it no longer passes when real messages would fail to sign in.
description.zh: 通过 /login 登录的 WorkBuddy 智能体会被正确识别为已登录。冒烟测试也改为在智能体设置的站点（国际站或国内站）上运行，不会再出现测试通过、实际对话却登录失败的情况。

title.en: Buttons in notifications are spaced properly again
title.zh: 通知里的按钮恢复正常间距

description.en: Buttons such as Refresh on the new-version notice had lost their padding and size.
description.zh: 例如新版本提示里的「刷新」按钮，此前丢失了内边距和尺寸。
